Special Branch,
March 30,1936.

Col. Fichebain, who is relinquishing charge
of the French troops in Shanghai, departs for
home on March 31. He will leave from the Customs
Jetty at 8 a.m. and a detachment of French troops
will be in attendance.

Jno Robertson
OFFICER IN CHARGE
SPECIAL BRANCH

1936年3月30日。

即将卸任上海法军指挥权的菲什班（Fichebain）上校，将于3月31日启程回国。他将于上午8时从海关码头离沪，届时将有一支法军分遣队到场送行。

约翰·罗伯逊（Jno Robertson）
主管警官
